adr_dispositions.rationale: Confirms Vitrine ownership and dependency direction without absorbing Core, producer, Meridian, Portia, Sunset, or institutional authority.
Preserves exact class-qualified identity and explicit cross-class confirmation without name-based inference.
Provides immutable purpose-specific Profile revisions, explicit activation, overlays, and migration.
Preserves staged Core discovery, canonical reload, exact compatibility, source authority, and Candidate evaluation.
Keeps producer-owned projections, field allowlists, native meaning, and Portia suppression intact.
Separates Candidate, Selection, Placement, presentation, annotation, reflection, approval, and exact Composition revisions.
Defines exact bytes, digest layers, immutable Editions, exports, issuance, submission, and nondestructive history.
Defines action-specific authorization, recipient scope, no-leakage behavior, redaction verification, and disclosure history.
Specializes Profiles for authority sources, cases, components, checklists, attestations, deadlines, batches, and external outcomes.

exit_conditions.condition: Candidate discovery uses Core plus exact producer contracts.
Cross-class identity is explicit and never guessed.
Purpose-specific Profiles are immutable and versioned.
Source artifacts and copied Snapshot bytes preserve exact provenance.
Portia inclusion remains exceptional and privacy-governed.
Issued Snapshot Editions never silently update.
Audience and recipient authorization remain separate.
Regulated examples remain versioned and non-operational.
Core, producer, Meridian, and Portia boundaries are current.
Sibling commit references are valid and accurately characterized.
No blocker or major finding remains unresolved.
Positive and negative corpus validation passes.
No real or restricted student data is present.
No sibling repository is modified and no new Core kind is required.
